patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Nextiva and Wati share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Nextiva and Wati share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Nextiva only if your buying job matches “SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/mo” rather than Wati's shape. Choose Wati only if your buying job matches “Official WhatsApp Business API platform with a shared team inbox, broadcasts, chatbots and” rather than Nextiva's shape. Workflow advantage: Nextiva leans business-phone, team-communication; Wati leans whatsapp-support, customer-follow-up. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Nextiva and Wati share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Nextiva is SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/month annual, with messaging apps including WhatsApp; Wati is Official WhatsApp Business API platform with a shared team inbox, broadcasts, chatbots and AI co-pilot — platform subscription (Growth/Pro/B.
- Workflow coverage skew: Nextiva-leaning business-phone, team-communication, contact-center vs Wati-leaning whatsapp-support, customer-follow-up, lead-nurturing.
- Researched limits: Nextiva — Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; Wati — Platform subscription is only part of the bill — Meta per-message charges vary by template category and recipient country.

Limitations — Nextiva: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; Analytics and AI assistance require Scale / higher plans or XBert add-on from $99/mo; Wati: Platform subscription is only part of the bill — Meta per-message charges vary by template category and recipient country; Growth includes 3 users and does not allow additional users at all.

Poor-fit cases: Nextiva is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included · Wati is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Platform subscription is only part of the bill — Meta per-message charges vary by template category and recipient country · Avoid Nextiva if you actually need Wati's motion (Official WhatsApp Business API platform with a shared team inbox, broadcasts, ch)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
